result.topic: Elemental burst recovery: first logical update and trigger-frame timing
result.question: Whether an elemental burst always skips recovery-budget advancement during its creation logical frame, or first advancement depends on when the trigger occurs relative to the host EPController.OnTick.

sources.title: 元素

sections.title: 元素损伤爆发（ElementBreak）
sections.short_quote: 元素损伤爆发开始时会立刻给予单位相应的效果，随后进入爆发冷却状态。
sections.paraphrase: Depleting one EP type triggers its burst. Burst effects are applied immediately, then recovery/cooldown prevents EP loss and external EP restoration. At burst completion all EP types are reset to their maxima.
supports: Immediate burst business effects after EP depletion
Recovery/cooldown lock and eventual EP reset
does_not_establish: Ordering between EP damage trigger and host EPController.OnTick
Whether expiry is checked before or after the current update decrement

sections.title: 攻击附带的元素损伤
sections.paraphrase: EP damage directly attached to an attack is usually processed after its HP damage; some Buff-based implementations can apply EP damage first. The subsection is marked incomplete.
does_not_establish: Global host update ordering or first recovery tick

sources.inspection: Read the complete mechanism content and searched page text for 帧 and 恢复速度; neither yielded a first-frame rule. This is absence of a statement in this inspected page, not proof that no such client rule exists.
